# Process all files: read content, compute title, create note
import re

for file_path in files:
    # Get file content
    file_data = apis.file_system.show_file(access_token=fs_token, file_path=file_path)
    content = file_data['content']
    
    # Extract filename without extension
    filename = file_path.split('/')[-1]
    if filename.endswith('.md'):
        filename = filename[:-3]
    # Replace underscores with spaces
    title = filename.replace('_', ' ')
    
    # Create note
    result = apis.simple_note.create_note(
        access_token=simple_note_token,
        title=title,
        content=content
    )
    print(f"Created note for {file_path}: {result}")
